moments.description: A blank black screen is shown before the web application loads.
The "todos" application is open with an empty input field displaying "What needs to be done?".
The item "Buy milk" is added to the list, showing "1 item left" with the "All" filter active.
The item "Finish the hackathon demo video" is added, displaying above "Buy milk" with "2 items left".
The item "Call mom" is added to the list above the existing items, with the footer reading "3 items left".
The item "Fix login bug" is added to the top of the list, and the counter updates to "4 items left".
The list displays four active items: "Fix login bug", "Call mom", "Finish the hackathon demo video", and "Buy milk" with "4 items left".
"Fix login bug" is marked completed with a checkmark and strikethrough text, the counter displays "3 items left", and a "Clear completed" button is visible.
"Finish the hackathon demo video" is checked and struck through, leaving "2 items left".
The "All" filter is selected, showing four items with "Fix login bug" and "Finish the hackathon demo video" checked and "2 items left".
The "Active" filter is highlighted, displaying only unchecked items "Call mom" and "Buy milk" with "2 items left".
The view remains settled on the "Active" filter with "Call mom" and "Buy milk" shown.
The "Completed" filter is highlighted, showing only completed items "Fix login bug" and "Finish the hackathon demo video".
The view remains settled on the "Completed" filter showing the two completed items.
The "All" filter is selected again, displaying all four items with "2 items left".
The "All" filter remains highlighted with all four todo items visible and "2 items left" displayed.
